title: Per-tenant calendarizable reset policy with fractional-day prorating
creator: Asha Patel
description: Problem: Customers want more flexible quota reset semantics than the current system (UTC midnight or rolling window). Use cases include billing-aligned monthly resets on customer fiscal calendars, tenant-local midnight resets across timezones, and prorated quota allocation for mid-cycle onboarding or plan changes. The current reset executor only supports fixed epoch-aligned windows and cannot deterministically handle fractional-day prorating for reserved capacity buckets across regions. This ticket implements a per-tenant configurable reset policy that supports: (1) calendar-based anchor dates (e.g., 1st of month at 00:00 tenant-local), (2) arbitrary reset offsets (e.g., 18:30 local time), and (3) fractional-day prorating when tenants change plans mid-period or when migrating tenants between reserved pools. The implementation must be idempotent, audit-friendly, testable, and compatible with reserved capacity lease semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Operators can set tenant.reset_policy to one of [UTC-epoch, tenant-local-calendar, fixed-offset] via admin API
Reset executor produces deterministic ledger snapshots and token delta entries with consistent ids for replay/rollback
Proration math produces identical results when applied in batch (offline) or during live reset runs
Reserved capacity leases are reconciled so tenants do not double-consume burst buckets during cross-pool migration
End-to-end integration tests for three scenarios: tenant onboarding mid-cycle, plan upgrade mid-cycle, cross-region migration with timezone shift
Monitoring: per-tenant reset_success and reset_duration metrics + anomaly alerts when >0.1% tenants fail reset
Migration path documented and rollout can be toggled per-customer via feature flag
No customer-visible billing discrepancies in a canary of 50 tenants over two cycles
tasks: Design API changes for tenant.reset_policy and admin UI controls
Implement reset_policy engine with pluggable anchors (UTC, tenant-local, fixed-offset)
Add ledger snapshot + idempotent reset token generation
Extend reserved-pool reconciler to consult reset timestamps and temporary debit holds
Create unit and integration tests covering edge DST transitions and leap seconds
Run closed canary on 50 low-risk tenants, compare billing ledger vs. baseline
Rollout to 10% of tenants, monitor for 14 days, then full rollout if stable
test_plan: Unit tests for proration math against canonical vector table (included in pr/1721)
Integration test fixture that simulates tenant in America/Los_Angeles moving to Asia/Singapore
Load test: execute reset executor across 10k tenants within a 5-minute window to validate performance
Chaos test: drop DB writes mid-reset and validate idempotent replay recovers correct ledger state
Billing regression test comparing invoices before/after migration for canary tenants
comments: 2026-02-20 - Asha Patel: RFC posted. Primary goal is deterministic resets for tenant calendars and consistent prorating. Initial design favors tenant-local anchor with UTC fallback for system jobs.

2026-02-23 - Sophie Li (Product): PM feedback — customers asked for billing-aligned resets (fiscal month) and ability to change reset day without losing credits. Request to expose plan-change proration preview in Console.

2026-02-25 - Miguel Torres: Engineering notes — implementing tenant-local anchor requires per-tenant timezone stored in Profile and a canonical midnight mapping. Concern: large migration cost for tenants missing timezone metadata. Proposal to infer from billing address and fall back to UTC with audit log.

2026-02-27 - Evan Brooks: Design review — suggested UI: 'Reset alignment' dropdown with preview text showing next three reset datetimes in tenant's timezone. Also recommends showing estimated prorated credits on plan-change modal.

2026-03-01 - Priya Menon (SRE): Reliability notes — add circuit-breaker that marks a tenant as 'deferred-reset' if reset executor fails 3x; deferred tenants go through a linearized reconciliation job to avoid double-deducts.

2026-03-03 - Miguel Torres: Implementation update — PR#1704 open with core engine and token-id mechanism. Running unit tests; ledger snapshot implementation pending review. Will add more integration tests next week.

2026-03-04 - Jordan Kim (Finance): Finance review — confirmed proration algorithm needs to match invoicing service rounding rules (bankers rounding, two decimals). Added a test vector file to pr/1721.
2026-03-05 - Asha Patel: Triage — moved ticket to In Progress. Added canary run plan and metrics to validate correctness before release-flag wide rollout.
rollout_plan: Stage 1: internal QA and reconciliation against synthetic ledger (2 days)
Stage 2: closed canary (50 tenants) for two billing cycles
Stage 3: 10% tenant cohort for 14 days with daily audit and rollback window
Stage 4: Gradual ramp to 100% over 7 days with realtime monitoring and on-call runbook
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Timezone inference errors cause resets at wrong local time -> Mitigation: require explicit timezone on tenant creation or surface 'unspecified' status in Console
Risk: Double consumption during pool migration -> Mitigation: temporary debit holds and reconciler that uses lease checkpoints to avoid double spending
Risk: Rounding differences between billing and invoice service -> Mitigation: shared math library and canonical test vectors reviewed with Finance
Risk: Long-running reset executor causes load spikes -> Mitigation: shard executor by tenant hash and progressive backoff with per-shard concurrency limits
notes_for_oncall_runbook: If reset_success_count drops by >50% in a region, flip feature flag billing.reset_policy_v1 off and run reconciliation job for last cycle
Escalate to Finance and SRE if customer_billing_delta_absolute > $10 for any canary tenant
